$Comment: The Mastery Trainer's conversation. The trainer never contracts: I will, does not, let us.
HOW A SCREEN IS PICKED. Start is walked in a fixed order: First (top to bottom), then a quest that
is READY to hand in, then one the trainer can OFFER, then one that is ACTIVE, then Fallback.
First holds three beats. The introduction comes first: while the player is carrying the quest that
sent them here (meet_the_mastery_trainer), pressing F opens a line written for a first meeting. Its
option carries the MarkTalked beat, which is what credits a talk step (pressing F alone credits
nothing), then drops into the menu. Then the tithe line, for a player carrying What You Already Paid
(mastery_tithe_credit): its option carries MarkTalked too, which finishes that quest, and opens the
trainer's quest list on it so the player collects the standing there. Then the lessons line, once a
day (Once with Period Daily, turning over at midnight UTC, OnceId lessons_fresh) for a player who has
collected the meeting or What You Already Paid, skipped while they have something to hand in. It pays nothing: talking earns
no standing with the trainer.
Quests routes a finished quest ahead of the menu: a player returning with a completed mastery quest
is greeted by ready_generic, the one hand-in line every quest here shares, whose menu opens the quest
list. A quest row points at a screen rather than a bare true so pressing F always shows a line first.
Add a row here when you add a quest that is collected at the trainer.
THE MENU. Every steady screen pulls in the trainer_menu group: the quest list, the lessons board
(shown once the meeting or What You Already Paid is collected, the same two quests that open the
board; the board itself, Mmo_Mastery_Lessons, opens only in the
Forgotten Temple), How am I doing? (the trainer's Reputation page, shown once the player has any
standing with the trainer), the mastery menu, and farewell.
The Header line mirrors the player's tracked objective at the top of the conversation.
To reword any line, override the dialogue.mmo_mastery_trainer.* keys in a language file.
